title: 10 minutes of uncut gameplay from the first mission of SALTLINE, my arcade flight combat game (Claude Code, Godot, local and cloud TTS)
author: KashinHS
selftext:
I posted the teaser (back when it was called Broken Meridian) and a dev update here before. Today I want to show you actual uncut gameplay. This is the first mission on the desktop build from start to finish, no cuts.

What happens in it:

You scramble before dawn because four bombers are heading for the island and the radar station has gone quiet. You climb through the clouds, the sun comes up, and the bombers are right there in front of you. The mission is basically on a tutorial level, with longer travel times between targets to ease players into the controls.

It's arcade on purpose. You carry more missiles than any real jet would and the flight model is forgiving. The part I want to feel real is the war around you (who attacks, why, what it costs the island), and that mostly shows up in later missions.

**What's new since the last post**

* The voices moved from QwenTTS to Fish Audio Drama 3. Delivery is a lot better, and I can write the direction into the line itself instead of a separate field.
* Eight missions are playable now. This is still the first one, because it doesn't spoil anything.

**Same setup as before**

Claude Code writes the code and the Blender scripts that build every model. Godot 4. Suno for music, ChatGPT image gen for 2D art (with renders of my own models as reference). I do the design, the story, the dialogue and the playtesting, and I decide what stays.

Any Feedback is welcome. Fire away :)

Video on YouTube: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kD1T0bC9J28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kD1T0bC9J28)

Homepage: [https://www.saltlinegame.com/](https://www.saltlinegame.com/)

comments.author: sanguilarity
comments.body:
It looks awesome! I'm curious how you arrived at this name though, as there is another AI-built game which got a lot of attention and has the same name: [https://saltline-game.com/](https://saltline-game.com/)

Completely different premises of course, but yeah the name might be confusing to some folks like me who have already heard of the other one.

replies.author: KashinHS
replies.body:
Thanks! I talked about the subject in my last post actually. The original viral saltline game was that one: [https://saltlinegame.pro/](https://saltlinegame.pro/)  
If you scroll further down it actually mentions my game ("Not the Saltline mobile game") 😅

My game was originally called "Broken Meridian" which was Claude's suggestion. Turned out that this name was already taken by another game that was released a few months earlier. I then renamed it to Saltline (in reference to the narrow strait between the two warring countries). Now that the other game went viral I will probably have to rename it again before I release it, but I won't do that for now... otherwise it probably gets taken again and I don't want to keep buying domains 🤣

replies.author: sanguilarity
replies.body:
Gotcha, that makes sense. Thanks for the reply, I was just curious about that when I saw the name and realized I'd seen it before.

Your game looks unique and awesome though, best of luck! I'll be looking forward to testing it out.
